Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying the time of commencement of regular legislative sessions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the time of commencement of regular legislativesessions; and amending RCW 44.04.010.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 44.04.010 and 1980 c 87 s 27 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Regular sessions of the legislature shall be held annually,commencing at 12:00 p.m. on the second Monday of January.
